story.en: Justin was born at Neapolis in Palestine around the beginning of the second century and searched through philosophical schools for knowledge of God. Christian tradition recounts that an elder directed him toward the prophets and Christ, after which Justin embraced Christianity while continuing to wear the philosopher’s cloak. In Rome he taught and wrote defenses of the Christian faith addressed to the wider Greco-Roman world. His First Apology and Dialogue with Trypho are especially important sources for second-century Christian belief, worship, baptism and Eucharistic practice. Under the prefect Rusticus, Justin and companions refused to sacrifice to the gods and were executed, probably in the 160s.
story.el: Ο Ιουστίνος γεννήθηκε στη Νεάπολη της Παλαιστίνης στις αρχές περίπου του 2ου αιώνα και αναζήτησε τη γνώση του Θεού μέσα από διάφορες φιλοσοφικές σχολές. Η χριστιανική παράδοση διηγείται ότι ένας γέροντας τον κατεύθυνε προς τους προφήτες και τον Χριστό, οπότε ασπάστηκε τον Χριστιανισμό χωρίς να εγκαταλείψει το ένδυμα του φιλοσόφου. Στη Ρώμη δίδαξε και έγραψε απολογίες της χριστιανικής πίστης. Η Πρώτη Απολογία και ο Διάλογος προς Τρύφωνα είναι πολύτιμες πηγές για την πίστη, τη λατρεία, το βάπτισμα και την Ευχαριστία του 2ου αιώνα. sections.title: Complete stored life
sections.text: Justin was born at Neapolis in Palestine around the beginning of the second century and searched through philosophical schools for knowledge of God. Christian tradition recounts that an elder directed him toward the prophets and Christ, after which Justin embraced Christianity while continuing to wear the philosopher’s cloak. In Rome he taught and wrote defenses of the Christian faith addressed to the wider Greco-Roman world. His First Apology and Dialogue with Trypho are especially important sources for second-century Christian belief, worship, baptism and Eucharistic practice. Under the prefect Rusticus, Justin and companions refused to sacrifice to the gods and were executed, probably in the 160s.
